title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
title_zh: Component Routing: 组件导向的自我提升GUI代理

paragraphs.en: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing , which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer–consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的 GUI 智能体会保留其生成的轨迹，并通过微调或将其检索到提示中返回给智能体，而比较这两种目的地的研究结果并不一致。 我们将此归因于经验单元：一个轨迹会将具有不同属性的项目组合在一起，因此对这一组合的结论取决于其内部构成。 为了解决这个问题，(i) 我们引入了组件路由，它将经验拆分为定位器、程序、状态事实和教训，并将每个组件发送到上下文或权重中；我们在三种主干模型家族、两种环境和三种种子设置下，对相同的项目进行了比较。 其中一个池有两个目的地：定位器和教训在权重中胜出，而程序和状态事实则在上下文中胜出。 (ii) 我们基于在任何训练之前测量的两个属性——重复性和状态条件性——拟合了一条规则；该规则在 24 个单元格中的 24 个都成功恢复了被排除的主干模型家族的目的地，两种干预措施使一个组件向边界移动，而通过该规则进行的路由优于所有基于完整轨迹的基线方法，并且平均比每个主干模型家族中表现更好的单一目的地高出 3.5 分。 (iii) 我们识别了训练以及生产方与消费方之间的差异如何改变这两个目的地的价值：请注意，当同一组件被写入权重后，读取值会下降，且对于重复频率最高的项目下降最为明显；上下文增益会随着信息差距的增大而增加，而权重增益则会随着策略差距的增大而减少。 代码和数据将会发布。

paragraphs.en: GUI agents that operate phones and desktops are increasingly improved with their own traces: an agent runs a batch of tasks, the trajectories are kept, and the experience is returned to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 操作手机和台式电脑的 GUI 智能体正借助自身的轨迹记录得到持续改进：一个智能体执行一批任务，其运行轨迹会被保留，而这些经验随后会反馈给该智能体。

paragraphs.en: Where that experience should go is an open decision. One line of work fine-tunes the agent on its successful trajectories; another keeps the trajectories, or notes distilled from them, in a library that is retrieved into the prompt. On MobileGym, an 8B agent whose whole pool goes to the weights gains 7.1 points of held-out success and one whose whole pool goes to the context gains 8.0, yet the two destinations disagree on which parts of the pool are responsible: the components that gain most in the weights are the ones that gain least in context (Figure 1 a). Figure 2 shows the smallest version of this. One trajectory on a weather application teaches where the search field is and that a city is saved by tapping Add on its preview; fine-tuning on the whole trajectory learns the first and loses the second.
paragraphs.zh: 这段经验应如何运用，仍是一个开放的决定。 一条工作流将智能体在其成功轨迹上进行微调；另一条则将这些轨迹或从中提炼出的要点存入一个知识库，并在提示中调用该知识库。 在 MobileGym 上，一个将全部池资源分配给权重的 8B 智能体，其保留测试中的成功率提升了 7.1 分；而另一个将全部池资源分配给上下文的智能体，则提升了 8.0 分。然而，这两种分配方式对池中哪些部分负责这一结果存在分歧：在权重中获益最多的组件，在上下文中的获益却最少（图 1a）。 图 2 展示了这一机制的最小版本。 在某个天气应用中，一条轨迹教会了用户搜索栏的位置，以及通过点击预览上的“添加”按钮来保存城市；而基于整条轨迹进行微调，则学会了前者，却丢失了后者。

paragraphs.en: We attribute this to the unit of experience. Existing methods treat a trajectory as the unit: success-filtered fine-tuning distills whole trajectories into the weights ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Men et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) , and retrieval keeps whole trajectories or trajectory-level skills in context ( Xiong et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Sui et al., 2026 ) . Comparisons of the two destinations reach opposite conclusions: internalized hints beat the prompt on tool tasks ( Alakuijala et al., 2026 ) , prompt-side updates beat gradient updates on web tasks ( Li et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , and the same skill representation helps one task and hurts another ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . A trajectory bundles items with different properties, so any conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此归因于经验单元。 现有方法将轨迹视为基本单元：经过成功筛选的微调会将完整轨迹蒸馏到模型权重中（Zhang et al., 2026；Men et al., 2026；Fan et al., 2026），而检索方法则会在上下文中保留完整轨迹或轨迹级别的技能（Xiong et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026；Sui et al., 2026）。 对这两种方法的对比得出了相反的结论：在工具任务中，内化的提示优于原始提示（Alakuijala et al., 2026）；在网络任务中，提示侧的更新优于梯度更新（Li et al., 2026；Agrawal et al., 2026）；而相同的技能表示对一项任务有益，却可能对另一项任务有害（Liu et al., 2026b）。 一条轨迹包含了具有不同属性的多个项目，因此关于该组合的任何结论都取决于其内部成分的混合方式。

paragraphs.en: Deciding where a piece of experience belongs requires two things: a property of the piece that can be measured before any training, and a comparison in which both destinations consume the same items and are read on the same held-out tasks. Existing comparisons pit one whole pipeline against another, so the items differ before the destinations do ( Alakuijala et al., 2026 ; Gou et al., 2026 ) , and none asks it per component.
paragraphs.zh: 决定一段经验应归属何处需要两个要素：一个在训练前即可测量的该段经验的属性，以及一种比较方法，其中两个目标都消耗相同的项，并在相同的预留任务上被读取。 现有的比较方法将一条完整的流程与另一条完整流程进行对比，因此各部分在到达目标之前就已经不同（Alakuijala 等，2026；Gou 等，2026），而且没有任何一种方法按单个组件进行询问。

paragraphs.en: We answer this question with component routing . Experience is split into four components, locators, procedures, state facts and lessons, and each component is characterized by two properties measured on the pool before any training: recurrence , how often its key comes up in unrelated tasks, and state-conditionality , how much its usefulness depends on the current state matching its source state. Each component is then sent to the context, to the weights, or to both, on the same items and the same held-out instances, across three backbone families and two environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过组件路由来回答这个问题。 经验被划分为四个组件：定位器、程序、状态事实和教训；每个组件都由两个在训练前于池中测量的属性所定义：重复性（其关键在不相关任务中出现的频率）和状态条件性（其有效性在多大程度上取决于当前状态与其源状态的匹配程度）。 随后，每个组件都会被发送到上下文、权重或两者之中，针对相同的项和相同的预留实例，并在三种主干架构家族和两种环境中进行。

paragraphs.en: Three observations follow. The four components split by destination: the route gain, weights minus context, is +4.9 points for locators and +1.5 for lessons, − - 4.2 for procedures and − - 4.1 for state facts (Figure 1 a). The two properties account for the split: a rule fitted with the tested backbone held out recovers the sign in 24 of 24 cells, an eightfold training dose moves procedures toward the weights by +3.5 points, and stripping the state condition from state facts costs 3.4. Routing each component by the rule exceeds the better single destination of each backbone by +3.5 points on average over three backbones and two environments, and the reverse assignment by +7.8 (Figure 1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 以下有三项观察结果。 按目的地划分的四个组成部分：路线增益、权重减去上下文，定位器为 +4.9 分，课程为 +1.5 分，程序为 − - 4.2 分，状态事实为 − - 4.1 分（图 1 a）。 这两个特性解释了这种划分：采用测试主干的拟合规则在 24 个单元格中恢复了符号，八倍训练剂量使程序向权重方向移动 +3.5 分，而从状态事实中移除状态条件则损失 3.4 分。 按该规则为每个组件分配路线，在三条主干和两个环境中平均比每条主干的最佳单一目的地高出 +3.5 分，而反向分配则高出 +7.8 分（图 1 b）。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (i) A measurement of where an agent’s own experience belongs: four components, two pool-level properties, and a paired comparison of the context and the weights on the same items across three backbones, two environments and three seeds. (ii) A routing rule in recurrence and state-conditionality that recovers the winning destination of every component on a held-out backbone family, with two interventions that move a component toward the boundary. (iii) An account of how training, information gaps and policy gaps shape experience reuse: the readout of high-recurrence notes falls to 16 percent once the same items are in the weights, most for the items that recur most, and the context route gains from an information gap while the weights route loses to a policy gap.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 (i) 一种衡量智能体自身经验归属位置的测量方法：包括四个组件、两个池级属性，以及对同一项在三条主干网络、两种环境和三个种子中上下文与权重的配对比较。 (ii) 一种递归和状态条件性路由规则，可在预留的主干网络族中恢复每个组件的获胜目标，并包含两种将组件向边界移动的干预措施。 (iii) 对训练、信息差距和政策差距如何塑造经验重用的解释：一旦相同项出现在权重中，高重复性笔记的读取率会降至16%，其中重复频率最高的项受影响最大；同时，信息差距会使上下文路线受益，而政策差距则会导致权重路线受损。

paragraphs.en: GUI agents are trained on trajectories, human demonstrations at first ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) and now their own rollouts in verifiable environments ( Wu et al., 2026j ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . What is kept from a trajectory varies: skills distilled into the weights ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , skill cards retrieved or distilled ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , hindsight-relabelled experience ( Men et al., 2026 ) , and memories built to survive interface change ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Diagnoses show that trajectory fine-tuning learns interface shortcuts as readily as semantics ( Gu et al., 2026 ) and that a form which helps grounding can hurt action prediction ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . Each of these works fixes one form and one destination. We split one pool into four components and let two measured properties decide where each goes.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 智能体最初是在轨迹上进行训练的，这些轨迹包括人类的演示（Wang 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2026a），而现在则使用它们在可验证环境中的自主运行轨迹（Wu 等人，2026j；Wang 等人，2026a）。 从一条轨迹中保留的内容各不相同：有的将技能提炼为模型权重（Fan 等人，2026），有的检索或提炼技能卡（Liu 等人，2026b），有的对经验进行事后重标注（Men 等人，2026），还有的构建记忆以应对界面变化（Sun 等人，2026）。 诊断结果表明，轨迹微调能够像学习语义一样轻松地掌握界面快捷方式（Gu 等人，2026），同时某种有助于语义落地的形式反而可能损害动作预测能力（Liu 等人，2026b）。 这些研究每一项都只针对一种形式和一种目标进行优化。 我们将一个池子拆分为四个组件，并让两个可量化的属性决定每个组件的去向。

paragraphs.en: Whether self-generated experience helps depends on who produced it and who consumes it ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026d ; Duan et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2025a ; Fang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2025c ; Pan et al., 2023 ; Tchalla et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026f ; Wu et al., 2026g ; Wu et al., 2026h ; Xing et al., 2025 ) : a stronger agent can specialize a smaller one through its weights ( Kim et al., 2026b ) , shared trajectory stores help consumers on either side of the ability gap ( Kim et al., 2026c ) , synthesized tools help only models weaker than their builder ( Lou et al., 2026 ) , and the gain from a harness changes with base ability in opposite directions across studies ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . Self-improvement loops are also fragile: memory gains move with seeds, task order and backbone ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , much of what a module stores comes from failed or falsely successful runs ( Hajimiri et al., 2026 ; Advani, 2026 ) , and repeated internalization collapses rather than compounds ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . These studies report the net effect of a producer or a consumer. We separate it into an information gap and a policy gap, measured on one pool across three backbone families and a size ladder.
paragraphs.zh: 自我生成的经验是否有帮助，取决于谁创造了它以及谁使用了它（Ding et al., 2025；Ding et al., 2026d；Duan et al., 2023；Fang et al., 2025a；Fang et al., 2025b；Fang et al., 2025c；Pan et al., 2023；Tchalla et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2026f；Wu et al., 2026g；Wu et al., 2026h；Xing et al., 2025）：一个更强的智能体可以通过其权重使较弱的智能体实现专业化（Kim et al., 2026b），共享的轨迹存储有助于能力差距两侧的消费者（Kim et al., 2026c），合成的工具仅对弱于其构建者的模型有效（Lou et al., 2026），而利用工具所带来的收益，在不同研究中会随基础能力的变化呈现相反的趋势（Lin et al., 2026；Wei et al., 2026）。 自我改进循环同样脆弱：记忆增益会因初始种子、任务顺序和基础架构的不同而变化（Ye et al., 2026），模块存储的许多内容来自失败或错误标记为成功的运行（Hajimiri et al., 2026；Advani, 2026），而重复的内部化过程会导致崩溃而非累积增强（Chen et al., 2026）。 这些研究报告了生产者或消费者的净效应。 我们将其分解为信息差距和政策差距，并在一个数据池上，针对三种基础架构家族和一条规模阶梯进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Every item carries a key, a note that the context route serves and a sample that the weights route trains on. A locator says where a named element sits on a screen: its key is application, role and element name, and its sample pairs the screenshot with a click on the element. paragraphs.en: We evaluate on MobileGym ( Wu et al., 2026j ) and AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) . MobileGym is a simulated phone with 20 applications and 416 task templates (160 training, 256 test) whose checker compares the application state to the task target; the same state is readable at every step, which makes the keys above well defined. A fixed rank rule holds out 5 applications; the remaining training templates form the pool (122 templates), and the test templates form two held-out tiers, new templates on practiced applications (165) and templates on unseen applications (59), with up to 8 instances per template and seed (1 106 paired instances per seed). AndroidWorld has 116 tasks on 20 real applications and an accessibility tree; 12 applications provide experience, 8 are held out, and 58 held-out tasks are run with four instances each (232 paired instances per seed). Held-out success is decided by each environment’s deterministic checker, with no model judge. Every arm of a backbone is evaluated on the same instances, and differences are read with a paired bootstrap over instances (10 000 resamples, 95 percent intervals), pooled over the two tiers and per tier. Producer and consumer are the same model from three families in the 7–8B range, GUI-Owl-1.5-8B ( Xu et al., 2026 , GUI-Owl-8B below;) , ScaleCUA-7B ( Liu et al., 2026a ) and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) ; a same-family ladder, Qwen3-VL 4B, 8B and 32B, serves the producer–consumer measurements. Pool sampling, training and instance sampling are controlled by three seeds, and the analysis of every result was fixed before the runs. Splits, instances and cost are in Appendices B and H.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (a, b) shows the route gain of each component, backbone and environment. Locators are better off in the weights on every backbone and in both environments (+4.9 points pooled over backbones on MobileGym), procedures and state facts are better off in the context ( − - 4.2 and − - 4.1), and lessons lean toward the weights by a margin whose interval includes zero in half of the cells (+1.5). The sign pattern does not depend on the backbone: the twelve MobileGym cells agree across the three families, and the AndroidWorld cells, whose state signature is read from the screen, repeat the pattern with the wider intervals of a smaller task set. Both destinations help every component. Against the base agent and pooled over backbones (Figure 4 c), the context gains between +1.8 and +5.2 points and the weights between +0.8 and +6.7; what differs is which route helps more, the weights for locators (+6.7 against +1.8) and the context for procedures (+5.2 against +1.0). Coexistence adds little where the weights already win. Serving the notes on top of the tuned model adds +0.1 points for locators and +3.5 for state facts, so the context remains useful exactly for the components that the context wins. The components differ before any training. Figure 4 (d) places the items on the plane of the two properties. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 (a) follows the Qwen3-VL family across sizes, in a batch where every procedures adapter trains on the same number of samples (Appendix B.1 ). Procedures read from the context help every consumer whoever produced them, and larger producers help more: the 8B consumer gains +3.6 points from its own procedures, +4.8 from those of the 32B model and +2.2 from those of the 4B model, and the 32B consumer still gains +3.2 from the procedures of the 8B model. The same items written into the weights follow a different rule. Fine-tuning the 8B consumer on the procedures of the 4B model changes it by − - 2.3 points, on those of the 32B model by − - 1.4, and on those of another family by − - 7.5 (Figure 5 b), while its own procedures give +0.9. The damage is policy mismatch, not information. The same other-family pool read from the context gives +3.6, and a producer of the other family retrained on the consumer’s own successes brings the weights route back to − - 2.0. Most of the weights gain on own procedures is practice. Fine-tuning on the consumer’s own procedures alone, without any transferred item, gives +0.6 against +0.9 with all samples, and the two agree within 1.1 points on all five consumers (Figure 5 a, filled markers), so the weights route pays for what the consumer already does more than for what it learns.

paragraphs.en: The readout probe replays a decision step with and without a retrieved note and records whether the action changes. Before training, a note changes the action in 42 percent of the probed steps, from 33 percent for procedures to 48 percent for lessons, at about the same rate on every consumer (Figure 6 a). After the same items are in the weights, the rate falls to 16 percent for locators and 15 percent for lessons but only to 22 percent for procedures, and the after-to-before ratio falls with the recurrence of the component (Figure 6 b, Spearman − - 0.92). The same holds among the items of one component: split into thirds by recurrence, the ratio falls from 0.73 to 0.11 for locators and from 0.63 to 0.11 for lessons (Table E.4 ). Redundancy rather than conflict. The drop is largest for lessons and locators, the two components that recur most and for which coexistence added the least above, and smallest for procedures, the component for which the context keeps its value after training. A note is read when it carries something the weights do not yet hold, and a component that recurs is the one the weights absorb.

To see what happens when the two disagree, we train the weights on version 1 of the OpenApps applications ( Ullrich et al., 2026 ) , serve notes from version 2, and record, at the first step of a task where the two versions call for different actions, whether the agent follows the note, the weights or neither (Figure 8 , bottom, shows one such step). On the new version, stale weights alone change the base agent by − - 8.4 points and fresh notes alone by +3.3; serving both scores between 2.7 and 12.7 points below notes alone. paragraphs.en: Routing by the held-out rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, on average over backbones, the better single destination. Table 2 compares them on the same held-out instances, with the gain of routing over each row on MobileGym in its last column (compute and tokens in Appendix H ). Routed sends each component where the held-out rule says, so its assignment on a backbone is fixed before that backbone is trained. Fitted on one half of the held-out templates instead, the rule gives the same assignment in five of the six folds, and routing leads the better single destination on the other half by +3.7 to +5.1 points on MobileGym and +2.4 to +2.6 on AndroidWorld (Table D.3 ). On the full set it exceeds the better single destination on every MobileGym backbone, by +4.4 points on average; on AndroidWorld it exceeds it by +5.0 with Qwen3-VL-8B and by +3.2 with ScaleCUA-7B , and matches it with GUI-Owl-8B . The single destinations fail on different components. All to the context forgoes the weights gain of locators, all to the weights the context gain of procedures and state facts; routing keeps both (Figure 8 , top). Components carry what whole trajectories do not. The best whole-trajectory baseline, three sampled attempts with self-retry, is +9.3 points below routing, and fine-tuning on whole trajectories, retrieval of one trajectory or of ten step records, and context-then-distill all stay below the single destinations. The lead comes from what the components extract: localization samples for locators, preference pairs drawn from failed attempts for lessons, and notes matched to the current state for procedures and state facts. Without the state match, the notes of procedures and state facts gain +1.3 and +1.6, as ten step records retrieved by task text do (+1.4); retrieved by the state signature instead, the same records gain +1.6 (Table E.1 ), still 3.6 and 3.4 points below the notes of procedures and state facts. Fine-tuning on whole trajectories gains +0.7, about as much as procedures in the weights (+1.0). The assignment is what matters. The reverse assignment loses +8.9 points against routing on MobileGym and +6.7 on AndroidWorld, and the in-sample rule assigns the same routes, so routing by the full fit differs by − - 0.2.
paragraphs.zh: 基于预留规则的路线规划优于所有完整轨迹基线方法，并且在不同骨干模型上的平均表现也优于更优的单目的地方法。 表2在相同的预留实例上对这些方法进行了比较，最后一列显示了在MobileGym上路线规划相对于每行方法的提升（计算和token相关结果见附录H）。 路线规划方法将每个组件发送到预留规则指定的位置，因此其在某个骨干模型上的分配在该模型训练之前就已经确定。 相反，若该规则在预留模板的一半上进行拟合，则在六个折叠中有五个能获得相同的分配；而在另一半数据上，路线规划在MobileGym上比更优的单目的地方法高出+3.7至+5.1分，在AndroidWorld上则高出+2.4至+2.6分（表D.3）。 在完整数据集上，它超越了所有MobileGym骨干模型中的更优单目的地方法，平均高出+4.4分；在AndroidWorld上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B时高出+5.0分，使用ScaleCUA-7B时高出+3.2分，而与GUI-Owl-8B的表现则相当。 这些单目的地方法在不同组件上表现不佳。 “全部用于上下文”的方法放弃了定位器的权重增益，“全部用于权重”的方法则失去了程序和状态事实的上下文增益；而路线规划方法同时保留了这两者（图8，顶部）。 各个组件承载了完整轨迹所不具备的信息。 最佳完整轨迹基线方法（三种带自我重试的采样尝试）比路线规划低+9.3分；而在完整轨迹上的微调、单个或十个步骤记录的检索，以及“先上下文后蒸馏”等方法，其表现均低于单目的地方法。 这种领先优势源于各组件所提取的信息：定位器所需的定位样本、从失败尝试中抽取的偏好对作为经验教训，以及与当前状态匹配的关于程序和状态事实的笔记。 若没有状态匹配，程序和状态事实相关的笔记增益分别为+1.3和+1.6分；通过任务文本检索十个步骤记录时，增益为+1.4分；而改用状态签名进行检索时，相同记录的增益为+1.6分（表E.1），但仍比程序和状态事实相关的笔记低3.6分和3.4分。 在完整轨迹上进行微调的增益为+0.7分，与权重中程序部分的增益（+1.0分）大致相当。 分配方式才是关键。 反向分配方法在MobileGym上比路线规划低+8.9分，在AndroidWorld上低+6.7分；而样本内规则分配的路线与路线规划相同，因此完整拟合下的路线规划仅相差−0.2分。

Figure 9 places the 720 cells of 15 producer–consumer pairs on 16 task families against the three gaps; the information and policy gaps vary almost independently across the cells (Spearman − - 0.13). The context gain rises with the information gap from +0.2 points in the lowest sixth of the cells to +11.3 in the highest (Spearman 0.65); the producer’s ability tracks it at 0.20 on its own and at 0.05 once the information gap is held fixed, and with the consumer’s headroom on the family held fixed the information gap keeps 0.65. sents.en: The weights gain falls with the policy gap from +4.0 points in the lowest sixth to − - 5.7 in the highest ( − - 0.52; − - 0.52 given the information gap) and rises with the information gap (0.49): fine-tuning buys the same information as the notes and pays for it on every state where the producer’s action is one the consumer would not take.
sents.zh: 权重增益随政策差距的增加而下降，从最低六分位中的+4.0点降至最高六分位中的− - 5.7点（− - 0.52；在信息差距固定的情况下为− - 0.52），并随信息差距的增加而上升（0.49）：微调能获得与注释相同的信息，并在所有生产者行为是消费者不会采取的行为的状态中为此付出代价。

paragraphs.en: A larger producer widens the information gap, a foreign one opens a policy gap, and each route follows its own. For the Qwen3-VL-8B consumer, the 4B, 8B and 32B producers of its family have information gaps of 0.04, 0.06 and 0.08 and the same policy gap (0.16); their notes gain more in that order, and in the weights only the consumer’s own samples gain (Figure 5 a), the practice term of Equation 6 . A foreign producer is a policy gap, not an information gap. The GUI-Owl-8B pool has the information gap of a same-family producer (0.07) and a policy gap of 0.46: its notes help as much as the consumer’s own, and its samples hurt (Figure 5 b). Retraining that producer on the consumer’s successes closes the policy gap (0.17), leaves the information gap (0.07), and brings its samples to what a same-family producer’s give.
paragraphs.zh: 规模更大的生产智能体会扩大信息差距，国外的生产智能体会造成政策差距，而每条路径都遵循自身的规律。 对于 Qwen3-VL-8B 消费者而言，其家族中的 4B、8B 和 32B 生产智能体的信息差距分别为 0.04、0.06 和 0.08，政策差距则相同（0.16）；它们的“notes”增益按此顺序递增，而仅消费者自身的样本在权重上有所增益（图 5a），即方程 6 中的实践项。 国外的生产智能体造成的是政策差距，而非信息差距。 GUI-Owl-8B 池具有同族生产智能体的信息差距（0.07）和 0.46 的政策差距：其“notes”的增益与消费者自身的相当，但样本则产生负面影响（图 5b）。 用消费者的成功数据对该生产智能体进行重新训练，可以消除政策差距（降至 0.17），但信息差距（0.07）仍然存在，同时使其样本表现达到同族生产智能体的水平。

paragraphs.en: After an upgrade the notes keep their value and the weights start over, because what the weights bought was practice. paragraphs.en: We presented component routing, which sends each component of a GUI agent’s own experience to the context or to the weights by two properties measured on the pool before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality. On the same items and held-out tasks across three backbone families and two environments, one pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. A rule in the two properties recovers the destination of every component on a held-out family and of both halves of a component split at its boundary, and routing by it beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, on average, the better single destination of each backbone. Note readout falls once the same component is in the weights, most for the components that recur most; context gains grow with the information gap and weights gains shrink with the policy gap, so where experience belongs also depends on who produced it and who consumes it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了组件路由方法，该方法根据在训练前对池进行测量的两个属性——重复性和状态条件性，将 GUI 智能体自身体验的每个组件发送到上下文或权重中。 在三个主干模型家族和两种环境中的相同项目与保留任务上，一个池有两个目的地：定位器和课程在权重中胜出，而程序和状态事实则在上下文中胜出。 这两个属性中的一条规则能够恢复保留模型家族中每个组件的目的地，以及在其边界处被分割的组件两部分的目的地；通过该规则进行的路由优于所有完整轨迹基线方法，并且平均而言优于每个主干模型中表现更优的单一目的地。 请注意，一旦同一组件进入权重，读取效果就会下降，其中重复频率最高的组件下降最为明显；上下文增益会随着信息差距增大而增长，而权重增益则会随着策略差距缩小而减少，因此经验归属何处也取决于其生成者和使用者。

paragraphs.en: MobileGym has 20 applications and 416 task templates in 24 suites, split by the benchmark into 160 training and 256 test templates. A template instantiates a task with sampled parameters, and the environment judges an episode by comparing the final application state with the target state. Applications are ranked by their number of training templates, and every fourth application in that ranking is held out as unseen; this gives 5 unseen applications. Training templates whose applications are all seen form the experience pool (122 templates). Test templates whose applications are all seen form the seen split (165), test templates whose applications are all unseen form the unseen split (59), and the 32 test templates that touch both are reported separately and enter no main-text number. Each held-out template is instantiated up to 8 times per seed (126 templates have 8 instances and 98 have one), with parameters fixed by (template, instance, seed) and stored, so every arm runs the same 1 106 instances per seed.
paragraphs.zh: MobileGym 包含 20 个应用程序和 416 个任务模板，分布在 24 个套件中，并根据基准测试分为 160 个训练模板和 256 个测试模板。 一个模板通过采样参数实例化一个任务，而环境则通过将最终的应用程序状态与目标状态进行比较来评估一个回合。 应用程序按照其训练模板的数量进行排序，该排序中每第四个应用程序被保留为未见过的；由此得到 5 个未见过的应用程序。 所有应用程序均为已见过的训练模板构成经验池（122 个模板）。 所有应用程序均为已见过的测试模板构成已见过分组（165 个），所有应用程序均为未见过的测试模板构成未见过的分组（59 个），而同时涉及两者的 32 个测试模板则单独报告，不计入正文中的任何数字。 每个保留的模板在每个种子下最多实例化 8 次（126 个模板有 8 个实例，98 个模板有 1 个实例），参数由（模板、实例、种子）确定并存储，因此每条臂在每个种子下运行相同的 1 106 个实例。

paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld has 116 tasks over 20 applications, judged by the official evaluator. The unseen tier takes 8 of the 20 applications (identifiers audiorec , draw , joplin , notes , osmand , retro , simplecal and vlc ). The 58 held-out tasks are instantiated four times per seed, 232 instances, and the remaining tasks form the pool. The state signature is the set of visible accessibility nodes (class, resource id, normalized text), capped at 500 nodes, together with the package and activity. Locator keys are (application, class, resource id or text); procedure keys are three consecutive action-target signatures; state-fact keys are the node signatures present in the successful state and absent in the failed one, at most five; lesson keys are as on MobileGym. Actions follow the official action space through each backbone’s own adapter.
paragraphs.zh: AndroidWorld 包含 20 个应用程序中的 116 项任务，由官方评估器进行评判。 未见的层级涉及这 20 个应用程序中的 8 个（标识符为 audiorec、draw、joplin、notes、osmand、retro、simplecal 和 vlc）。 58 个预留任务在每个种子中实例化四次，共生成 232 个实例，其余任务则构成任务池。 状态签名由可见的无障碍节点集合（类、资源 ID、规范化文本）组成，最多包含 500 个节点，并附带包和活动的信息。 定位键为（应用程序、类、资源 ID 或文本）；过程键为三个连续的动作-目标签名；状态事实键为成功状态中存在而失败状态中不存在的节点签名，最多五个；课程键与 MobileGym 中的定义一致。 动作通过每个主干模型自身的适配器遵循官方动作空间。

sents.en: The 58 held-out tasks are instantiated four times per seed, 232 instances, and the remaining tasks form the pool.

sents.en: The state signature is the set of visible accessibility nodes (class, resource id, normalized text), capped at 500 nodes, together with the package and activity.
sents.zh: 状态签名由可见的无障碍节点集合（类、资源 ID、规范化文本）组成，最多包含 500 个节点，并附带包和活动的信息。

sents.en: Locator keys are (application, class, resource id or text); procedure keys are three consecutive action-target signatures; state-fact keys are the node signatures present in the successful state and absent in the failed one, at most five; lesson keys are as on MobileGym.
sents.zh: 定位键为（应用程序、类、资源 ID 或文本）；过程键为三个连续的动作-目标签名；状态事实键为成功状态中存在而失败状态中不存在的节点签名，最多五个；课程键与 MobileGym 中的定义一致。

sents.en: Actions follow the official action space through each backbone’s own adapter.
sents.zh: 动作通过每个主干模型自身的适配器遵循官方动作空间。

paragraphs.en: On MobileGym the base agent of each family runs every experience template 20 times at temperature 1 with a fresh instance each time, once per seed. Every step records the screenshot, the environment state, the element list, the action and its target. On AndroidWorld the pool runs each pool task ten times. The four component extractors run on the pool once, and the recurrence and state-conditionality of every item are computed from the pool alone. The coordinates of a cell are the mean recurrence and the median state-conditionality over the items of its component, merged over the three seeds. For the producer ladder of Section 6 the pools are repeated with the 4B and 32B members of the Qwen3-VL family and the 32B member of the GUI-Owl family as producers.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MobileGym 中，每个家族的基智能体对每个体验模板以温度 1 运行 20 次，每次使用新的实例，每个种子运行一次。 每一步都会记录屏幕截图、环境状态、元素列表、动作及其目标。 在 AndroidWorld 中，池会重复执行每个池任务十次。 四个组件提取器会在池上运行一次，并且每个项目的重复性和状态条件性仅根据池计算得出。 一个单元格的坐标是其组件中各项目重复性的均值和状态条件性的中位数，并基于三个种子进行合并。 对于第 6 节的生成器阶梯，池会重复使用 Qwen3-VL 家族的 4B 和 32B 成员以及 GUI-Owl 家族的 32B 成员作为生成器。

paragraphs.en: The measurements of Sections 4.2 and 6 come from one batch of their own. Every procedures adapter of this batch trains on 5 600 samples drawn from the producer’s pool (1 900 for the 32B consumers), so every producer enters the weights at the same training budget, and its own-procedure arms are separate runs from those of Table 1 . The batch groups the held-out templates into 16 task families: eight single-application suites, three cross-application suites and five kinds of task shared across applications (search and filter, compose and send, settings toggles, media control and multi-step forms).
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节和第 6 节的测量数据来自一个独立的批次。 该批次的每个程序适配器都在从生产者池中抽取的 5600 个样本上进行训练（其中 32B 消费者使用 1900 个样本），因此每个生产者在相同的训练预算下输入权重，且其自身程序分支的运行与表 1 中的运行相互独立。 该批次将预留的模板分组为 16 个任务家族：八个单一应用套件、三个跨应用套件以及五种跨应用共享的任务类型（搜索与筛选、组合与发送、设置切换、媒体控制和多步骤表单）。

paragraphs.en: The conflict measurement of Section 5.3 uses OpenApps ( Ullrich et al., 2026 ) , whose 15 tasks over six applications exist in two application versions. Each version is sampled 20 times per task. The weights route is trained on version 1 items, the notes are served from version 2, and every arm runs on all three families and three seeds, on 150 version-2 instances per seed (ten goal variants per task). At the first state where the two versions’ successful procedures diverge, the arm’s action is compared with the version-2 note and with the version-1 weights without notes, under the same-action rule of Appendix B.3 ; the shares of Section 5.3 count 520 such steps, 312 on GUI-Owl-8B and 104 on each other family.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5.3 节的冲突测量使用了 OpenApps（Ullrich 等人，2026），其分布在六个应用程序上的 15 项任务存在于两个应用程序版本中。 每个版本在每项任务上均采样 20 次。 权重路由基于版本 1 的项目进行训练，注释则来自版本 2；每个臂在所有三个系列和三种种子设置下运行，每种子设置使用 150 个版本 2 实例（每项任务包含十个目标变体）。 在两个版本的成功流程首次出现分歧的状态中，根据附录 B.3 的“相同动作”规则，将臂的动作与版本 2 的注释以及无注释的版本 1 权重进行比较；第 5.3 节的份额统计了 520 个此类步骤，其中 312 个在 GUI-Owl-8B 上，其余 104 个在其他每个系列上。

paragraphs.en: All arms use greedy decoding, the official step limit, the native screen resolution, and the same stored instances. An episode is a success when the environment judge accepts the final state. Every reported difference between two arms is paired over (template, instance, seed) and carries a percentile interval from 10 000 bootstrap resamples of the paired differences. Cells pool the three seeds; per-seed values give the subscripts of the tables.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体都使用贪心解码、官方的步数限制、原生屏幕分辨率以及相同的存储实例。 当环境判定接受最终状态时，一个回合即视为成功。 每两个智能体之间报告的所有差异均基于（模板、实例、种子）进行配对，并附带来自 10,000 次自助重采样所得配对差异的百分位区间。 各单元格合并了三种种子；每种种子的值对应表格的下标。

paragraphs.en: none : the base agent with the evaluation prompt and no experience; the zero of every gain.
paragraphs.zh: none：带有评估提示但无经验的基线智能体；所有收益的起点。

paragraphs.en: C_G, C_P, C_F, C_L : the context route of one component. At every step the items of the same application are ranked by the Jaccard similarity of their source state signature to the current one. Exact matches (at least 0.9) come first and relaxed matches (at least 0.5) fill up to five notes, appended to the prompt as a notes block. Procedures retrieve the skill file of the most similar task text first and the step-level items within it second.
paragraphs.zh: C_G、C_P、C_F、C_L：一个组件的上下文路线。 在每个步骤中，同一应用程序的项目会根据其源状态签名与当前签名的雅可比相似度进行排序。 完全匹配（至少 0.9）排在首位，宽松匹配（至少 0.5）最多可补充五个音符，并以“音符块”的形式附加到提示中。 流程首先获取最相似任务文本的技能文件，其次获取其中的步骤级项目。

sents.en: C_G, C_P, C_F, C_L : the context route of one component.
sents.zh: C_G、C_P、C_F、C_L：一个组件的上下文路线。

sents.en: At every step the items of the same application are ranked by the Jaccard similarity of their source state signature to the current one.
sents.zh: 在每个步骤中，同一应用程序的项目会根据其源状态签名与当前签名的雅可比相似度进行排序。

sents.en: Exact matches (at least 0.9) come first and relaxed matches (at least 0.5) fill up to five notes, appended to the prompt as a notes block.
sents.zh: 完全匹配（至少 0.9）排在首位，宽松匹配（至少 0.5）最多可补充五个音符，并以“音符块”的形式附加到提示中。

sents.en: Procedures retrieve the skill file of the most similar task text first and the step-level items within it second.
sents.zh: 流程首先获取最相似任务文本的技能文件，其次获取其中的步骤级项目。

paragraphs.en: C_c_exact, C_c_relaxed : the context route restricted to the exact or to the relaxed tier; their difference against none gives the online state-conditionality of Equation 4 .
paragraphs.zh: C_c_exact、C_c_relaxed：将上下文路线限制在精确层级或宽松层级；它们与 none 的差异给出了方程 4 中的在线状态条件性。

paragraphs.en: W_G, W_P, W_F : the weights route of one component, a LoRA adapter fine-tuned on the component’s items rendered as samples (Appendix C ). W_L trains the adapter by preference optimization, with the successful action as chosen and the failed action as rejected.
paragraphs.zh: W_G、W_P、W_F：一个组件的权重路由，即在该组件以样本形式呈现的项目上微调的 LoRA 适配器（附录 C）。 W_L 通过偏好优化训练适配器，其中成功动作被选中，失败动作被拒绝。

sents.en: W_G, W_P, W_F : the weights route of one component, a LoRA adapter fine-tuned on the component’s items rendered as samples (Appendix C ).
sents.zh: W_G、W_P、W_F：一个组件的权重路由，即在该组件以样本形式呈现的项目上微调的 LoRA 适配器（附录 C）。

sents.en: W_L trains the adapter by preference optimization, with the successful action as chosen and the failed action as rejected.
sents.zh: W_L 通过偏好优化训练适配器，其中成功动作被选中，失败动作被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: CW_G, CW_P, CW_F, CW_L : the weights-route adapter served with the notes of the same component. Every note-bearing step also runs once without the note, which gives the after-training readout of Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: CW_G、CW_P、CW_F、CW_L：与同一组件的注记一同提供的权重-路线适配器。 每个带有注记的步骤也会在无注记的情况下运行一次，从而得到第 4.3 节的训练后输出结果。

sents.en: CW_G, CW_P, CW_F, CW_L : the weights-route adapter served with the notes of the same component.
sents.zh: CW_G、CW_P、CW_F、CW_L：与同一组件的注记一同提供的权重-路线适配器。

sents.en: Every note-bearing step also runs once without the note, which gives the after-training readout of Section 4.3 .
sents.zh: 每个带有注记的步骤也会在无注记的情况下运行一次，从而得到第 4.3 节的训练后输出结果。

paragraphs.en: all_C : the four libraries served together, at most two notes per component and eight in total, exact matches first.
paragraphs.zh: all_C：四个库同时提供服务，每个组件最多两个音符，总计八个，优先匹配完全一致的项。

paragraphs.en: all_W : one adapter trained on the locator, procedure and state-fact samples together, then preference-optimized on the lessons from that adapter.
paragraphs.zh: all_W：一个在定位器、流程以及状态-事实样本上联合训练的适配器，然后基于该适配器产生的经验进行偏好优化。

paragraphs.en: routed : each component sent where the rule fitted with the family held out says (Appendix D ). The components sent to the weights are trained as in all_W restricted to those components; the components sent to the context are served with the all_C quota. The assignment is written to disk before the adapter is trained.
paragraphs.zh: 路由：每个组件都被发送到规则与家族所指定的位置（附录 D）。 发送到权重的组件按照 all_W 的方法进行训练，但仅限于这些组件；发送到上下文的组件则使用 all_C 配额提供服务。 在适配器训练之前，分配结果会被写入磁盘。

sents.en: routed : each component sent where the rule fitted with the family held out says (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 路由：每个组件都被发送到规则与家族所指定的位置（附录 D）。

sents.en: The components sent to the weights are trained as in all_W restricted to those components; the components sent to the context are served with the all_C quota.
sents.zh: 发送到权重的组件按照 all_W 的方法进行训练，但仅限于这些组件；发送到上下文的组件则使用 all_C 配额提供服务。

sents.en: The assignment is written to disk before the adapter is trained.
sents.zh: 在适配器训练之前，分配结果会被写入磁盘。

paragraphs.en: anti_routed : the same with every destination reversed.
paragraphs.zh: anti_routed：与每个目的地都相反的情况相同。

paragraphs.en: routed_self : the destinations read from the family’s own observed signs, used as an in-sample routing reference; GUI-Owl-8B only.
paragraphs.zh: routed_self：从该家族自身观察到的迹象中读取的目的地，用作样本内路由参考；仅限 GUI-Owl-8B。

paragraphs.en: B1_bon : three samples of the same instance at temperature 1. The main-text number keeps the first attempt that the agent declares complete, and the last attempt otherwise (self-retry).
paragraphs.zh: B1_bon：在温度为 1 的情况下，同一实例的三个样本。 正文中的编号保留智能体宣布完成的第一个尝试，否则保留最后一个尝试（自我重试）。

sents.en: B1_bon : three samples of the same instance at temperature 1.

paragraphs.en: B2_wholetraj_sft : supervised fine-tuning on every step of every successful pool episode.
paragraphs.zh: B2_wholetraj_sft：对每个成功池子回合的每一步进行监督微调。

paragraphs.en: B3_wholetraj_k1 : the action sequence of the single successful pool episode with the most similar task text, pasted into the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: B3_wholetraj_k1：与任务文本最相似的成功池单轮次中的动作序列，已粘贴到提示中。

paragraphs.en: B4_atomic_k10 : ten step-level records (state change, action) retrieved by task-text similarity, without state matching.
paragraphs.zh: B4_atomic_k10：通过任务文本相似度检索到的十个步骤级记录（状态变化、动作），无需状态匹配。

paragraphs.en: B5_icl_distill_P, B5_icl_distill_F : context-then-distill. The context route of the component runs on the experience templates as a teacher (ten episodes per template), and its successful trajectories are fine-tuned into the weights without a notes block.
paragraphs.zh: B5_icl_distill_P, B5_icl_distill_F：先上下文后蒸馏。 该组件的上下文路径以教师身份在经验模板上运行（每个模板十次迭代），其成功轨迹会被微调至权重中，且没有注释块。

sents.en: B5_icl_distill_P, B5_icl_distill_F : context-then-distill.
sents.zh: B5_icl_distill_P, B5_icl_distill_F：先上下文后蒸馏。

sents.en: The context route of the component runs on the experience templates as a teacher (ten episodes per template), and its successful trajectories are fine-tuned into the weights without a notes block.

paragraphs.en: W_P_dup m m , W_F_dup m m : the source episodes of the component are copied m m times into the pool before extraction, so the training set of the weights route, and with it the training dose of every key, grows m m -fold while the notes do not change; m = 8 m=8 on all three families, m ∈ { 2 , 4 } m\in\{2,4\} on GUI-Owl-8B only.
paragraphs.zh: W_P_dup m m , W_F_dup m m : 组件的源片段在提取前被复制到池中 m m 次，因此权重路线的训练集以及每个键的训练剂量都会增长 m m 倍，而音符则保持不变；在所有三个系列中，m = 8 m=8，而在 GUI-Owl-8B 中，m ∈ { 2 , 4 } m\in\{2,4\}。

paragraphs.en: C_P_destate, C_F_destate : the same notes retrieved by task-text similarity only, without the state signature.

paragraphs.en: A locator item becomes one sample per source step: the screenshot and the instruction to tap the named element, with the tap coordinates as the target. A procedure item becomes the step-by-step samples of the successful trajectories of its task family, with the sub-goal sequence as the thought. A state-fact item becomes its source step, task, screenshot and history, with the predicate as the thought and the action as the target. A lesson item becomes a preference pair on its source state, the successful action as chosen and the failed action as rejected, trained by preference optimization from the same adapter configuration. Success-filtered fine-tuning takes every step of every successful pool episode; context-then-distill takes the successful teacher episodes of the context route, at the sample count of the weights route of the same component; the copy interventions repeat the source episodes of a component before extraction, so their sample counts are the multiples listed in the table.
paragraphs.zh: 定位项在每个源步骤中生成一个样本：包括屏幕截图和点击指定元素的指令，其中点击坐标为目标。 流程项转化为其任务族成功轨迹的分步样本，其中子目标序列为思考过程。 状态事实项转化为其源步骤、任务、屏幕截图和历史记录，其中谓词为思考过程，动作为目标。 经验项转化为关于其源状态的偏好对：成功动作被选中，失败动作被拒绝，并通过相同适配器配置的偏好优化进行训练。 成功过滤微调会采用每个成功池子回合中的每一步；“上下文-再蒸馏”方法则采用上下文路径中成功的教师回合，其样本数量与同一组件权重路径的样本数量一致；复制干预措施会在提取前重复某个组件的源回合，因此其样本数量为表格中列出的倍数。

paragraphs.en: The notes of a component are its items rendered as one line each in a fixed template. A locator note names the element, its role and its position; a procedure note gives the sub-goal sequence of its skill file and the next sub-goal; a state-fact note states the condition that must hold before its action; a lesson note names the action to avoid in its state and the action to take instead. At every step the library of the current application is ranked by the Jaccard similarity between each item’s source state signature and the current signature, exact matches (at least 0.9) before relaxed matches (at least 0.5). The top five notes are appended to the prompt as a notes block, and the rest of the prompt is the base agent’s. Procedures are retrieved in two stages: the skill file of the most similar task text, then the step-level items within it. The aggregate context arms serve at most two notes per component and eight in total, exact matches first. Prompt tokens are recorded with and without the notes block on every step and enter Appendix H .
paragraphs.zh: 组件的说明是将其各项内容按固定模板分别渲染为一行。 定位说明会指明元素、其角色及其位置；流程说明会给出其技能文件中的子目标序列以及下一个子目标；状态事实说明会陈述其动作执行前必须满足的条件；经验说明会指明在其状态下应避免的动作以及应替代采取的动作。 在每个步骤中，当前应用的库会根据各项内容的源状态签名与当前签名之间的雅可比相似性进行排序，优先匹配精确匹配（至少 0.9），其次为宽松匹配（至少 0.5）。 排名前五的说明会被附加到提示词中形成一个说明块，而提示词的其余部分则来自基础智能体。 流程分两个阶段检索：首先检索最相似任务文本的技能文件，然后检索其中的步骤级内容。 聚合上下文最多为每个组件提供两个说明，总共不超过八个，且优先选择精确匹配项。 每个步骤都会记录包含与不包含说明块的提示词标记，并录入附录 H。

paragraphs.en: Lessons and state facts lie closest to the boundary, so each of them is split by item recurrence at the full-fit boundary for its mean κ 0 \kappa_{0} , and both halves are sent to both routes (Appendix B ). The halves differ in recurrence and hardly in state-conditionality, and no fit used them: their destinations were read off the full fit before the runs, and the fold that holds a family out gives the same side. Table D.4 lists the twelve halves; every half above the boundary is better off in the weights and every half below it in the context, with intervals clear of zero, by +4.3 points between the two halves of lessons and +4.9 between those of state facts.
paragraphs.zh: 课程与状态事实最接近边界，因此它们各自在完全拟合边界处被项目重复性分割，以对应其均值 κ₀ \kappa_{0}，且两个半部分都会被发送到两条路线（附录 B）。 这两个半部分在重复性上存在差异，但在状态条件性上几乎无差别，且没有任何拟合使用了它们：它们的目的地在运行前已从完全拟合中读取，而容纳一个家族的折叠结构会给出相同的一侧。 表 D.4 列出了这十二个半部分；边界上方的每个半部分在权重上表现更佳，而边界下方的每个半部分在上下文中表现更佳，且两者之间的区间均明显不为零：课程的两个半部分之间相差 +4.3 分，状态事实的两个半部分之间则相差 +4.9 分。

paragraphs.en: The context route of locators and state facts serves three or ten notes instead of five.
paragraphs.zh: 定位器和状态事实的上下文路由服务于三或十个节点，而非五个。

paragraphs.en: The weights route of locators and state facts is trained at rank 64 and 128 instead of 16, at the same number of epochs.

paragraphs.en: The locator comes from the weights and the state fact and the procedure from the context; with everything in the weights the agent reaches the preview and leaves it without Add.
paragraphs.zh: 定位器来自权重和状态事实，而程序则来自上下文；当所有信息都存在于权重中时，智能体便能达到预览状态，并在不添加任何内容的情况下离开该状态。

paragraphs.en: When a learned route and a note call for different entries on the same menu, the agent takes the action of the note.
paragraphs.zh: 当已学习的路线和笔记要求在同一个菜单中选择不同的条目时，智能体会执行笔记中的操作。

paragraphs.en: Every arm is evaluated on the same held-out instances (Appendix B.3 ). Two accounts differ between arms: the training compute of the adapter an arm trains, and the prompt tokens it spends per episode. Table H.1 lists both for every arm of Table 2 on MobileGym with GUI-Owl-8B , as means over seeds; the other two families train the same arms at the same configuration on pools of the same size. Adapter training is booked per training sample at the rates of one H100, and pool sampling at a fixed per-episode rate that every arm reading the pool shares. Prompt tokens are counted on every step with the notes block present, so the ratio to the base agent is the token cost of the context route at the interaction budget of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都在相同的预留实例上进行评估（附录 B.3）。 不同智能体之间存在两个差异：智能体在训练过程中使用的适配器训练计算资源，以及每轮交互所消耗的提示词标记数。 表 H.1 列出了 MobileGym 与 GUI-Owl-8B 环境下表 2 中每个智能体的两项指标（以种子值的平均值表示）；其余两个系列则使用相同的配置，在相同规模的池子上训练相同的智能体。 适配器训练按每份训练样本分配一个 H100 的速率进行预订，而池采样则以固定的每轮交互速率运行，所有读取该池的智能体共享此速率。 提示词标记在每一步都会根据注释块的存在情况进行计数，因此与基础智能体的比率即为论文所述交互预算下上下文路径的标记成本。

paragraphs.en: English rendering of the Qwen3-VL prompt. You are an expert operator of a mobile GUI agent. Given the task, the current screenshot and the history of operations, analyse the screen and output one action to interact with the phone and complete the task. Coordinates have their origin at the top left, x x to the right and y y downward, both in the range 0 to 1000. The fifteen actions, in JSON, are click, double tap, long press, type (with an optional point and an optional clear flag), swipe, drag, back, home, recent apps, enter, wait, open app, submit an answer, complete the task with a short note, and abort with a reason. The output is a <THINK> block that states what the screen shows, what to do next and which element to operate, followed by an <ANSWER> block with one JSON action. Coordinates must be numbers in 0 to 1000, the JSON must be valid, decisions follow the screenshot, questions are answered with the answer action, and the complete action is used only after the task has been carried out.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-VL提示词的英文呈现。 你是一个移动GUI智能体的专家操作员。 根据任务、当前截图和操作历史，分析屏幕并输出一个与手机交互以完成任务的操作。 坐标的原点位于左上角，x轴向右延伸，y轴向下延伸，范围均为0到1000。 十五种操作以JSON格式表示，包括：点击、双击、长按、输入（可选指定位置和清除标志）、滑动、拖动、返回、主页、最近应用、进入、等待、打开应用、提交答案、完成任务并附加简短说明，以及带理由的取消操作。 输出为一个<THINK>块，其中说明屏幕显示内容、下一步操作及需要操作的元素，随后是一个包含一个JSON操作的<ANSWER>块。 坐标必须是0到1000之间的数值，JSON必须有效，决策需基于截图作出，问题应通过“答案”操作回答，而“完成”操作仅可在任务执行完毕后使用。

paragraphs.en: The user turn of a step carries the current screenshot and, on the first step of the history window, the instruction text below with the task and the summary of previous actions filled in. GUI-Owl-1.5-8B keeps a window of the last four steps, each as its screenshot followed by the full model output of that step, and lists older steps as one line each; ScaleCUA-7B sends the current screenshot with a one-line history; Qwen3-VL-8B keeps its previous outputs as text and sends the screenshot of the current step only. A weights-route arm and the base agent receive exactly these messages. A context-route arm receives the same messages plus one text part appended after the current screenshot, the notes block of Appendix I.3 , and nothing is appended on a step without retrieved items. For the readout probe of Section 4.3 , every step that received a notes block is also run once without it; both outputs are logged, and the action with the block is the one executed.

paragraphs.en: English rendering of the templates. A locator note reads “On this page of {app}, the element ‘{name}’ ({role}) is tapped at ({x}, {y})”. A procedure note reads “In {app}, after ‘{name1}’ and ‘{name2}’, the next step is usually ‘{name3}”’. A state-fact note reads “Before doing ‘{name}’ in {app}, the following must hold: {pred1}; {pred2}; …”, with at most five predicates. A lesson note reads “In this state of {app}, do not do ‘{name_fail}’; do ‘{name_success}’ instead”. A predicate is one of three forms over a path of the application state, with list identifiers replaced by a placeholder: “{path} exists”, “{path} is set (non-empty)”, or “{path} must be the value the task requires”; keys that change on every run, such as timestamps and identifiers, never enter a predicate. Retrieval and the per-step quota are those of Appendix C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 模板的英文呈现。 一条定位说明写道：“在 {app} 的此页面上，元素 ‘{name}’ ({role}) 在坐标 ({x}, {y}) 处被点击。” 一条流程说明写道：“在 {app} 中，完成 ‘{name1}’ 和 ‘{name2}’ 后，下一步通常是 ‘{name3}’。” 一条状态事实说明写道：“在 {app} 中执行 ‘{name}’ 之前，必须满足以下条件：{pred1}; {pred2}; …”，最多包含五个谓词。 一条经验说明写道：“在 {app} 的此状态下，不要执行 ‘{name_fail}’；应改为执行 ‘{name_success}’。” 谓词是应用状态路径上的三种形式之一，其中列表标识符被替换为占位符：“{path} 存在”，“{path} 已设置（非空）”，或 “{path} 必须为任务要求的值”；每次运行都会变化的键，例如时间戳和标识符，绝不会进入谓词。 检索和每步配额遵循附录 C.2 的规定。
